title: LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2610.01926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Increasing depth of transformer models improves recognition, but it comes at a substantial cost. Each additional layer requires more parameters, which makes the process computationally inefficient. We ask whether additional processing can focus on integrating features already computed. Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer (LAST) first processes all tokens, then reuses the same blocks to refine only the class token over fixed audio features, thereby making later passes inexpensive. On AudioSet, ten-pass LAST achieves 0.345 mean average precision, exceeding a twelve-layer sequential transformer by 2.1% relative with 49.4% fewer parameters, 42% fewer multiply-accumulate operations, and 9.8% higher measured throughput. Across separately trained models, increasing the pass count from two to ten improves accuracy while adding only 1.2% computation. translated_abstract: 增加Transformer模型的深度可以提升识别性能，但代价高昂。每增加一层都需要更多参数，使整个过程的计算效率低下。我们探讨是否能让额外的处理专注于整合已计算好的特征。循环音频频谱图Transformer（LAST）首先处理所有token，然后复用相同的模块，在固定的音频特征上仅对类别token进行细化，从而使后续循环的计算成本很低。在AudioSet上，十次循环的LAST达到了0.345的平均精度均值（mAP），以相对提升2.1%的性能超越十二层的顺序Transformer，同时参数减少49.4%，乘累加运算减少42%，实测吞吐量提高9.8%。在分别训练的模型中，将循环次数从两次增加到十次可提升准确率，而计算量仅增加1.2%。进一步的评估显示，该方法对时间掩蔽以及各种其他听觉增强具有更好的鲁棒性。
tldr: LAST通过循环复用相同的Transformer模块、在固定音频特征上仅反复细化类别token，以更少的参数和计算量超越了更深的顺序式Transformer，实现了更高效的音频识别。
en_tdlr: LAST reuses the same transformer blocks to refine only the class token over fixed audio features, outperforming deeper sequential transformers with fewer parameters and less computation.
